Official municipal guide documented locating a predio by clave predial, activating the ‘Límite – Predios’ layer, and selecting a lot in the map table; no parcel feature payload was returned by the PDF.
Official municipal Consulta de Ficha Predial page loaded; it requires a parcel key/search inputs and was not used to request unsafe or personal fields.
Public ArcGIS item metadata identified the Fénix Web AppBuilder application and public viewer URL.
ArcGIS application configuration/data request returned SB_0005: subscription disabled; no service URL, field schema, CRS, or geometry response obtained.
Same public ArcGIS item data request returned subscription-disabled error; no retry with credentials or private tokens was attempted.
